# ProfilleAI

> ProfilleAI is an AI-powered job platform: an AI profile and resume builder, per-job resume tailoring, AI cover letter generation, a resume scoring/analysis tool, AI-driven job matching with ghost-job scoring, and a Chrome extension that shows match analysis and quick-fills application forms on job sites like LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, and Lever. The free plan requires no credit card and includes a limited monthly/lifetime allowance of tailoring, cover letters, and parsing; higher limits and batch tailoring come with the Pro and Pro+ plans.

Core product pages:
- [Home](https://www.profilleai.com/): overview of the platform.
- [Pricing](https://www.profilleai.com/pricing): Free, Pro, and Pro+ plans, feature-by-feature comparison.
- [Chrome Extension](https://www.profilleai.com/extension): the browser side panel that analyzes a job posting, tailors your resume, and quick-fills application forms.
- [Jobs](https://www.profilleai.com/jobs): AI-matched job feed, with ghost-job likelihood scoring applied to listings.
